rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=noise, fd_recon_init_t=1.0, fd_recon_eta=0.0, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-10 INIT=noise (fully generative), breast-native wdm-wavelet UNCONSTRAINED (DC OFF). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: steps 8 vs 16 identical (rmse0.01130 vs 0.01131) -> NFE not the limiter, prior is the ceiling. Best t=0.5 eta=0.0 steps=8. All hr=0; DC-off floor ~0.0113. (2) Failure mode: FBP-warm-start recons plateau; unknown = how much the FBP init contributes vs the prior alone. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init fbp->noise (start from pure N(0,I) at t=1, no FBP warm-start), eta=0.0 steps=8. (4) HYPOTHESIS: with NO FBP anchor and eta=0 (no DPS), the recon is UNCONDITIONAL prior sampling -> rmse MUCH worse (the prior draws a plausible breast, not THIS one). This bounds the pure-generative extreme and shows the FBP warm-start is what keeps DC-off recon near-usable. Confirms the prior alone cannot solve the inverse problem. (5) BUDGET: noise-init 8-step still <10min. (6) Loop continues.
